checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One playable music audio file is delivered
must.why: A 15 s WAV with sound was delivered, with a download link.

must.item: Music sounds upbeat with clear rhythmic pulse
must.why: Audio was not heard; the description claims punchy drums and a groove.

must.item: Opening establishes music promptly without long silence
must.why: Peak -1 dB and sound present, but the lead-in cannot be judged.

must.item: Usable as reel bed without glitches or abrupt cutoff
must.why: The ending and glitches cannot be judged without hearing it.

summary: A 15-second WAV music file was delivered with a clear description of an upbeat vocal-free pop track, but its quality could not be judged by ear.
